bench_01_clean_hard_cuts.description: Standard clean anime/action cuts every 1.0s with 120 BPM on-beat percussion
bench_01_clean_hard_cuts.notes: Optimal baseline test: all cuts align with 0ms delta.

bench_02_offset_sync_cuts.description: Intentionally desynchronized cuts (beats land 120ms after each cut)
bench_02_offset_sync_cuts.notes: Stress test for sync scoring: cuts must be penalized for 120ms delta.

bench_03_fast_phonk_montage.notes: Stress test for rapid pacing and high cut density.

bench_04_isolated_flash_frames.description: 2 scenes with single-frame white strobes at 1.0s and 4.5s
bench_04_isolated_flash_frames.notes: Tests detector resilience: naive detectors register 5 cuts; adaptive detector must detect 1 real cut.

bench_05_slow_emotional_takes.notes: Verifies classification of slow emotional pace.

bench_06_dissolves_fades.description: Gradual crossfade/dissolve transitions (0.5s duration) without hard cuts
bench_06_dissolves_fades.notes: Tests detector behavior on gradual dissolves vs hard cuts.

bench_07_silent_video.description: Clean video cuts with no audio stream present in MP4 container
bench_07_silent_video.notes: Tests graceful degradation: audio beats reported as absent without crashing.

bench_08_clipping_audio.description: Video with harsh digital clipping and high True Peak (>0 dBTP)
bench_08_clipping_audio.notes: Tests audio quality detector: must flag clipping detected.

bench_09_strobe_overload.description: Extreme 15Hz strobe effect inside a scene (stress tests false positive cut rejection)
bench_09_strobe_overload.notes: Crucial test: checks if detector explodes with 30 false cuts or detects flash overload.

bench_10_varied_dynamic_pacing.description: Dramatic pacing shift (buildup 2.0s -> rapid cuts 0.5s -> cooldown 2.5s)
bench_10_varied_dynamic_pacing.notes: Tests pacing variance and dynamic range of shot lengths.
